summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO/IEC 27002 Lead Manager exam and build practical skills for selecting, implementing, and managing information security controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for information security professionals who coordinate or support the selection, implementation, and management of controls in an ISMS. It is relevant if you advise control owners, maintain information security practices, or assess controls in your organization.
prerequisites: To participate, you need a fundamental understanding of ISO/IEC 27002 and comprehensive knowledge of information security controls.
